messages:
Ryan: Hey folks — planning a retro PC + Switch LAN at the office this Saturday 6pm. I can bring a router and a spare power strip. Anyone else in? :joystick:

Helen: I'm in. Do we have enough surge protectors? My PSU is old and I'd rather not fry it. :grimacing:

Amir: I'll bring a teensy power strip and a couple of Ethernet cables. Also can share AoE Steam account for multiplayer if needed.

Jen: Count me in. Can someone bring extra Switch Pro controllers? I only have one dock.

Sam: Games? Rocket League? Smash? Also down for Age of Empires II DE. :trophy:

Ryan: Plan: 6pm set up, 7pm games. I'll bring a small gigabit switch and Wi‑Fi isolated SSID for the LAN. If anyone needs IPv4 static IPs DM me. Example quick assign command I use locally:
```
# set static ip on macOS
sudo ifconfig en0 inet 192.168.50.10 netmask 255.255.255.0
```

Helen: Oof command lines. :sweat_smile: I'll bring two surge protectors and an extension cord. Also FYI I'm allergic to peanuts — please no satchel of snacks with nuts? :pray:

Amir: Also bringing an HDMI capture + a tiny switch so we can stream a match if people want. No guarantee on quality haha.

Jen: Pizza? lunchbot, poll?

lunchbot: Poll created: "LAN snacks" — options: Pizza / Order-in / BYO — vote with :pizza:, :fries:, :bento: (auto-posted)

Sam: Pizza for the win. I'll take pepperoni. :pizza:

Ryan: Cool. RSVP scribble: Ryan, Helen, Amir, Jen, Sam. If you want to crash at my place after, I have 2 extra sleeping mats. Also bring ethernet adapters for modern laptops (USB-C -> RJ45) if you have them.

Helen: Bringing one USB-C adapter.

Amir: I'll bring an extra Switch dock and 2 USB-C adapters.

Jen: See you Saturday! :smiley:
